text.en:
- 2 -
(c) Actual exenses for lodging and subsistence
shall not exceed 216 a day in Manila, exclusive of
actual, necessary and reasonable transportation ex-
penses, which shall not exceed 24 a day, and 78 a day
in the province.
The different heads of departments shall issue regu-
lations in conformity with the provisions of this Order so
that official trios shall not be made except when absolutely
necessary in the interest of the public service.
This Order shall take effect as of December 1, 1945.
Done in the City of Manila, this 5th day of December,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-five,
and of the Commonwealth of the Philippines, the eleventh.
SERGIO OSMENA
President of the Philippines
By the President:
